checks.detail: All four exact source inequalities verified with escaped Unicode literals; initial checker mismatch was PowerShell stdin encoding, not manuscript content.

resolved_findings.issue: Executive table described ten earlier fits rather than ten paired fitting seeds.
resolved_findings.resolution: Builder regenerated with paired fitting seeds; final hash checked.

resolved_findings.issue: Companion actuals prose called a flow-level effect an additional workload tradeoff.
resolved_findings.resolution: At parent request, changed to additional false-alert tradeoff. Numeric JSON and manuscript unchanged.

methodological_assessment.HARKing: No undisclosed reclassification found: post-result synthesis is repeatedly explicit; no original success gate or infeasible seed was removed.
methodological_assessment.matched_cohorts: New primary policy tables use exactly six feasible supports; all ten weighting arms retain infeasible supports. Exposed test/older fit comparisons remain separate.
methodological_assessment.dual_mean_gain: Verified conditional reference-vs-normal-threshold gains and heterogeneity; larger selection-label information and other-stage costs are disclosed.
methodological_assessment.original_90pct_screen: Investigator-chosen limits remain exactly as frozen, including strict greater-than/less-than boundaries; new framing does not claim original success.
methodological_assessment.novelty: Established methods and bounded applied contribution are accurately separated; no first-method or institution-acceptance guarantee.
methodological_assessment.reference_review: All 17 reference entries have corresponding body use and reasonable connection to the described question. Publication-status limitations remain explicit. Primary literature was not re-searched or externally reverified in this review.

limitations: Numerical comparison uses completed audited public aggregates and confusion-matrix-derived findings; no fitting, inference, threshold revision or new test evaluation.

Appendix E and exposed-test tables were recomputed here; inherited secondary tables, software/accounting and source preparation were also covered by the earlier source-manuscript review, whose hash is bound.
Rendered Word/PDF layout requires separate visual inspection.
